mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 70 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Area High School under a New Moon. The temperature will settle at an overnight low of 65 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various roles, asking for a commitment of twice a month. Also, keep an eye out for the latest City Hall notices regarding upcoming elections for the August primary and the November general election.

There is plenty to do, with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or hear music at Paddy Mac's, followed by the Cave Carnival on Saturday.
On August 5, officers located and arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after a brief pursuit.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM, so stop by and grab a scoop before they close.
